searchText: is there web3js for eth2? Let me give you some links: - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Merge/mainnet-readiness.md - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3675.md - https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/tree/dev/specs/merge Also, feel free to ask questions in <#692062809701482577> We have a web3-eth2-core and web3-eth2-beaconchain package with web3js atm. Currently rewriting these packages in Typescript as part of our 4.x upgrade. Anything specific you're looking for that's missing? Right now would be a great time to take input on what you'd like to see that doesn't exist
